arguments.command:
cd /workspace && sed -i 's/self\.coordinator\.retile(self\.rho)/self.coordinator.retune(self.rho)/' submission/te/session.py && timeout 110 python3 -u -c "
import sys, time, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import gen, verify
from protocol import loads as raw_loads, validate as raw_validate
ENV = dict(os.environ); ENV['PYTHONPATH']='/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission'; ENV['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/workspace/native'
bad = 0
for seed in range(0, 20):
    text = json.dumps(gen.valid_request(seed), separators=(',',':'))
    try:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=text.encode(), capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=20)
        if p.returncode:
            print(seed, 'EXIT', p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[-500:], flush=True); bad += 1; continue
        verify.check(text, p.stdout.decode())
    except verify.Bad as e:
        print(seed, 'VERIFY FAIL', e, flush=True); bad += 1
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print(seed, 'TIMEOUT', flush=True); bad += 1
print('bad', bad, flush=True)
" 2>&1 | tail -20
